observations: White hair dryer with grey accents and a grey protective cap.
Brand 'MMAAT BATHROOMS' is printed on the side in blue text.
The device is mounted on a wall using a bracket.
A white coiled power cord is attached to the rear.
The wall behind the dryer shows significant brown staining and discoloration.
The interior of the dryer is not visible.

claims.evidence: The brand is visible, but 'MMAAT quality' is a subjective marketing claim.

risks.risk: The heating element may be burnt out or the motor may be dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the dryer powered on and blowing air.

risks.risk: The internal heating chamber may be clogged with hair or debris.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior of the dryer with the cap removed.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used and requiring cleaning

risks.risk: The wall mount may be loose or the bracket may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the bracket and the wall mount in use.

proof_requests: Video of the hair dryer powered on and running.
Photo of the interior of the dryer with the cap removed.
Photo of the wall mount and bracket to confirm it is secure.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
